author: lguohan

2. yes process will occupy 100% cpu for one core
3. run test_cpu_memory_usage.py

**Describe the results you received:**

test to fail

comments.author: lolyu
comments.body: I misunderstood the requirement for `cpu usage percent over a single core` so the cpu usage calculated now is divided by the cores count. Changing back to `irix` mode to solve this.
